chunks: They invoke besides Him only females; and they invoke only Satan the obstinate rebel.

key_terms.إِنَاثاً: Females (referring to pagan deities or angels)

ai.seo_question: Who do the polytheists invoke besides God according to Surah An-Nisa?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse critiques the pre-Islamic Arab practice of attributing femininity to angels or deities like Al-Lat, Al-Uzza, and Manat, emphasizing their inherent weakness and inability to intercede. It further identifies the ultimate object of their invocation as 'Shaytan al-Murid' (the rebellious Satan), highlighting the spiritual delusion of mistaking created beings for divine powers. This underscores the core Tawhid principle that true divinity belongs solely to Allah, free from gender or physical form.
